in_arabic.name: هداية
in_arabic.meaning: الله يهدي من يشاء هداية الحق والسلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: هداية هي اسم مؤنث يدل على الهداية من الله تعالى، وتعني السلام والرشاد الذي يمنحه الله للإنسان لكي يمشي على الطريق المستقيم، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة آية 272: ﴿مَن يَشاءُ اللَّهُ أَنهُ يَهْدِيَهُ يَجْعَلْ صَدْرَهُ لِلْإِسْلَامِ أَسْلَمَ وَمَن يُرِد أَنْ يُضِلَّهُ يَجْعَلْ صَدْرَهُ ضَيِّقًا حَرِّصًا كَأَنَّهُ يَصْعَدُ فِي السَّمَاءِ كَذَلِكَ يَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ الرِّجْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ لَا يَأْمَنُونَ﴾

in_urdu.name: ہدایہ
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ کی ہدایت، راست دکھانے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہدایہ ایک مؤنث نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ تعالیٰ کی ہدایت، راست دکھانے والا، جو شخص کو صحیح راستے پر چلنے کے لئے رہبری کرتا ہے، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں جگہ جگہ آیا ہے جیسے سورة آل عمران میں ہے جہاں اللہ تعالیٰ فرماتے ہیں کہ ﴿وَالَّذِينَ اهْتَدَوا زادَهُمْ هُدىً وَآتاهُمْ ذِكْرَاهُمْ﴾

in_english.name: Hadaya
in_english.meaning: Guidance, righteousness, and spiritual direction from Allah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hadaya is derived from the Arabic root 'h-d-y' which means 'to guide' or 'to lead to the right path'. In Islamic context, it signifies the guidance provided by Allah to lead individuals to the righteous path. This concept is frequently mentioned in the Quran, emphasizing the importance of divine guidance for spiritual and moral well-being. The name reflects the aspiration for a person to be guided by divine wisdom and to live a life of spiritual fulfillment.

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name Hadaya holds a special place in Islamic culture as it embodies the noble act of giving and receiving with generosity and kindness. This name highlights the significance of generosity and love in Islamic society, reflecting the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who encouraged Muslims to be charitable and kind to one another. Hadaya is often given as a name to remind its bearer of the importance of giving and receiving with open hearts and as a reminder to be grateful for the blessings bestowed upon them.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the Islamic name Hadaya carries a deep significance as it represents God's infinite love and mercy towards His creation. Hadaya reminds us that all good things come from Allah, and that we should be grateful for the blessings we have received. It also serves as a reminder to bestow kindness, love, and generosity upon others, just as Allah has bestowed upon us. As such, Hadaya is a powerful name that inspires a spiritual connection with the giver and the receiver, promoting a deeper sense of compassion, gratitude, and love towards Allah and others.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Khaldun's 'Al-'Ibar', Chapter 11: The Berbers and the foundation of the Maghrib The name Hadaya carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibn Khaldun describes the city of Hadaya (Awdaghost) as a center of power for the Berber tribes in the Maghrib, especially during the Almohad period (1121-1269). He highlights its strategic location between the Atlas Mountains and the Sahara Desert, making it a significant trade hub between the north and the south.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Bakri's 'Al-Maslik wa-l-Mamalik', Section on Ifriqiya and Maqorib (Maghrib) The name Hadaya carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Al-Bakri mentions Hadaya (Awdaghost) as an important city in the Maghrib, with a strong fortress, a large market, and a thriving population. He also notes that it was a stopover for merchants traveling from the Mediterranean to the Sahara.
